recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier horizontal composition featuring a central weathered photograph of a man at a rustic outdoor bar, flanked by dark, heavily textured bands containing wide-tracked, distressed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the central sepia-toned image and the dark, near-black outer bands.
Integration of background environmental text with foreground subject.
Symmetry in typographic placement across the top and bottom horizontal axes.
Heavy grit and film grain texture unifying all layers.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure seated on a barstool, mid-shot, occupying the middle horizontal third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's silhouette against the lighter background of the bar interior.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top text, down to the central figure, then to the bottom text, following the vertical stack.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark textured bands at the top and bottom provide significant negative space for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and burnt umber in the textured bands.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated sepia and warm greys in the central photograph.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted copper or bronze for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast between the central image highlights and the dark borders.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and greyscale

characterSpecificRedesigns: Artificial distressing and 'eroded' edges applied to all glyphs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both top and bottom text to maintain industrial symmetry.
graphicDevices: Heavy film grain and dust scratches

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric clarity and wide stance.
Provides the square, industrial feel common in Americana aesthetics.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-tier layout. The middle tier is a grainy, sepia-toned photo of a man in a baseball cap and sunglasses leaning on a rustic outdoor bar with faded Spanish signage. The top and bottom tiers are dark charcoal with heavy dust, scratch, and film grain textures. Add thin horizontal lines separating the tiers.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in a bold extended geometric sans-serif to the top and bottom bands. Use extremely wide tracking. Apply a weathered, eroded texture to the letters so they appear integrated into the film grain.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking wide enough to span the width of the image?
Is the texture consistent across the photo and the text bands?
Are the colors desaturated to a sepia/charcoal palette?
Is the central figure clearly defined against the bar background?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'floating' text that doesn't match the background grain.
Ensure the horizontal dividers are perfectly straight.
Verify the man's pose feels relaxed and candid.
Confirm the Spanish text in the background is blurred/distressed enough to be secondary.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central desaturated environmental portrait with heavy-textured dark headers/footers and wide-tracked geometric sans-serif type for a rugged, vintage-modern aesthetic.
